premises.text: Despite huge social networks, people make only about four valuable connections per year on average
premises.evidence_span: four is the number of valuable, on average, valuable connections being made in a given year

premises.text: Existing networks reinforce known ties but are not designed to discover hidden valuable people
premises.evidence_span: existing networks today are fantastic, excellent in reinforcing connections with people that we've already made. They don't, however, and they're not designed to actually discover hidden networks

premises.text: iPhone app makes, manages, and tracks one-on-one introductions with permission and status on the go
premises.evidence_span: Somazi's iPhone app allows you to make, manage, and track valuable introductions on the go

premises.text: Socializing Your Real-Time Needs web service broadcasts needs across networks and leverages hidden networks of contacts
premises.evidence_span: Socializing Your Real-Time Needs is a web service that allows you to intelligently connect to the masses

premises.text: Dashboard tracks post reach, views, messages, and rebroadcasts to discover how connections form
premises.evidence_span: The dashboard allows you to see all the different posts that I've done in the past. It allows me to track the views, it tracks the reach
